criteria.name: GA001

Inspect output/balance_review.xlsx, output/balance_review_brief.docx, output/playtest_queue.csv.
criteria.reasoning: Candidate correctly cites UCI webpage (DOI correct) and collector code gist URL. However, fails to identify the critical format difference: the collector code (dota2ApiLoader.py) outputs 15 columns (matchId, win, cluster, game_mode_name as STRING, lobby_name as STRING, 10 raw hero_id values), while the CSV has 117 columns (win, clusterid/gamemode/gametype as integers, 113 one-hot hero indicators).
